## [Skills - Docs by LangChain](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/skills)

## [​](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/skills#usage)  Usage
```
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from deepagents.backends.filesystem import FilesystemBackend

backend = FilesystemBackend(root_dir="./my-project")

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6",
    backend=backend,
    skills=["./my-project/skills/"],
)
```

## [​](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/skills#add-tools-to-skills)  Add tools to skills
Passing `skills` to `create_deep_agent` creates a `SkillsMiddleware` for you.

```
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from deepagents.backends.filesystem import FilesystemBackend
from deepagents.middleware import SkillsMiddleware
from langchain.tools import tool

@tool
def list_issues(team: str) -> str:
    """List open issues for a Linear team."""
    return f"{team}-101: Login page times out"

@tool
def create_issue(team: str, title: str) -> str:
    """Create a Linear issue and return its ID."""
    return f"{team}-102: {title}"

backend = FilesystemBackend(root_dir="./my-project", virtual_mode=True)

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6",
    backend=backend,
    middleware=[\
        SkillsMiddleware(\
            backend=backend,\
            sources=["/skills/"],\
            tools=[list_issues, create_issue],\
        ),\
    ],
)
```

## [​](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/skills#backends-and-remote-skill-loading)  Backends and remote skill loading
```
from urllib.request import urlopen
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from deepagents.backends import StateBackend
from deepagents.backends.utils import create_file_data
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

checkpointer = MemorySaver()
backend = StateBackend()

skill_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/refs/heads/main/libs/code/examples/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md"
with urlopen(skill_url) as response:
    skill_content = response.read().decode('utf-8')

skills_files = {
    "/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md": create_file_data(skill_content),
}

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="fireworks:accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2",
    backend=backend,
    skills=["/skills/"],
    checkpointer=checkpointer,
)

result = agent.invoke(
    {
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is langgraph?"}],
        # Seed the default StateBackend's in-state filesystem (virtual paths must start with "/").
        "files": skills_files,
    },
    config={"configurable": {"thread_id": "12345"}},
)
```

```
from urllib.request import urlopen
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from deepagents.backends import StoreBackend
from langgraph.store.memory import InMemoryStore

store = InMemoryStore()
backend = StoreBackend(
    namespace=lambda _rt: ("filesystem",),
    store=store,
)

skill_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/refs/heads/main/libs/code/examples/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md"
with urlopen(skill_url) as response:
    skill_content = response.read().decode('utf-8')

backend.upload_files(
    [("/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md", skill_content.encode("utf-8"))]
)

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="google_genai:gemini-3.6-flash",
    backend=backend,
    store=store,
    skills=["/skills/"],
)

result = agent.invoke(
    {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is langgraph?"}]},
    config={"configurable": {"thread_id": "12345"}},
)
```

```
from urllib.request import urlopen
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from deepagents.backends.filesystem import FilesystemBackend
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

# Checkpointer is REQUIRED for human-in-the-loop
checkpointer = MemorySaver()

skill_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/langchain-ai/deepagents/refs/heads/main/libs/code/examples/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md"
with urlopen(skill_url) as response:
    skill_content = response.read().decode('utf-8')

backend = FilesystemBackend(root_dir="/Users/user/{project}", virtual_mode=True)
backend.upload_files(
    [("/skills/langgraph-docs/SKILL.md", skill_content.encode("utf-8"))]
)

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="google_genai:gemini-3.6-flash",
    backend=backend,
    skills=["/skills/"],
    interrupt_on={
        "write_file": True,
        "read_file": False,
        "edit_file": True,
    },
    checkpointer=checkpointer,  # Required for filesystem operations!
)

result = agent.invoke(
    {"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is langgraph?"}]},
    config={"configurable": {"thread_id": "12345"}},
)
```

## [​](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/skills#skills-for-subagents)  Skills for subagents
```
from deepagents import create_deep_agent

research_subagent = {
    "name": "researcher",
    "description": "Research assistant with specialized skills",
    "system_prompt": "You are a researcher.",
    "tools": [web_search],
    "skills": ["/skills/researcher/"],  # Subagent-specific skills
}

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="google_genai:gemini-3.6-flash",
    skills=["/skills/main/"],  # Main agent and GP subagent get these
    subagents=[research_subagent],  # Researcher gets only its own skills
)
```

```
model = init_chat_model(model="gpt-5")

```

```
You are an expert researcher. Your job is to conduct \

    model=model,
    system_prompt=research_instructions,
)

        {"role": "user", "content": "What is deepagent?"}\
    ]
})
```

## Customization 3: Custom Tools

```
import os
from typing import Literal
from tavily import TavilyClient
from deepagents import create_deep_agent

tavily_client = TavilyClient(api_key=os.environ["TAVILY_API_KEY"])

def internet_search(
    query: str,
    max_results: int = 5,
    topic: Literal["general", "news", "finance"] = "general",
    include_raw_content: bool = False,
):
    """Run a web search"""
    return tavily_client.search(
        query,
        max_results=max_results,
        include_raw_content=include_raw_content,
        topic=topic,
    )

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model=model,
    tools=[internet_search],
)

result = agent.invoke({
    "messages": [\
        {"role": "user",\
         "content": "What is deepagent in Agentic AI?"}\
    ]
})
```

```
}
```

```
from deepagents import create_deep_agent

    tools=[internet_search, data_analysis_tool],
    instructions=research_instructions,
```

# What Are LangGraph Deep Agents? The Harness Explained
## What the Harness Actually Adds?
Deep Agents is assembled from middleware.

### File system Middleware
Adds `ls`, `read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `glob`, `grep` and `delete`, plus an optional `execute` tool when the backend supports it. The filesystem is the agent's working memory.

## FAQ
Calling `create_deep_agent()` returns a compiled LangGraph graph with planning, a virtual filesystem, subagent delegation, summarization and prompt caching already attached as middleware.

**‍** A: Six pieces: `TodoListMiddleware` for planning, `FilesystemMiddleware` for file operations, `SubAgentMiddleware` for delegation with isolated context, `SummarizationMiddleware` for context compaction, `AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware` for token savings on Anthropic models, and `PatchToolCallsMiddleware` for repairing interrupted tool calls. `MemoryMiddleware` and `SkillsMiddleware` attach when you use memory or skills.

# Deep Agents overview

> Build agents that can plan, use subagents, and leverage file systems for complex tasks

Deep Agents is the easiest way to start building agents and applications that are powered by LLMs—with built-in capabilities for file systems for context management, subagent-spawning, and long-term memory.
Optional capabilities such as [task planning](#task-planning) and [skills](#skills) extend the harness when your use case needs them.
You can use deep agents for any task, including complex, multi-step tasks.

Deep Agents comes with the following capabilities:

* **Take actions in an environment**: Take actions via tools, read and write files, execute code
* **Connect to your data**: Load memories, skills, and domain knowledge at the right moment
* **Manage growing context**: Summarize history and offload large results across long runs
* **Parallelize tasks**: Delegate to general or specialized subagents running in isolated context windows
* **Stay in the loop**: Pause for human approval at critical decision points
* **Improve over time**: Update memory, skills, and prompts based on real usage

See [Core capabilities](#core-capabilities) for a full breakdown of each component.

## Core capabilities

![Agent harness capabilities by category](https://mintcdn.com/langchain-5e9cc07a/jtty0O--UJOKG0nK/oss/images/agent_harness_capabilities.svg?fit=max\&auto=format\&n=jtty0O--UJOKG0nK\&q=85\&s=0ff671d72badd0844826660dfcb04391)

Deep Agents is an ["agent harness"](/oss/python/concepts/products#agent-harnesses-like-the-deep-agents-sdk). It is the same core tool calling loop as other agent frameworks, but with built-in capabilities that make agents reliable for real tasks:

> **[Execution environment](#execution-environment)**
>
> Tools, virtual filesystem, optional sandbox, and REPL (interpreter)

> **[Context management](#context-management)**
>
> Skills, memory, summarization, context offloading, and prompt caching

> **[Delegation](#delegation)**
>
> Subagent spawning and optional task planning

> **[Steering](#steering)**
>
> Human-in-the-loop approval and interrupts

[`deepagents`](https://pypi.org/project/deepagents/) is a standalone library built on top of [LangChain](/oss/python/langchain/)'s core building blocks for agents. It uses the [LangGraph](/oss/python/langgraph/) runtime for durable execution, streaming, human-in-the-loop, and other features.

[LangChain](/oss/python/langchain/) is the framework that provides the core building blocks for your agents.
To learn more about the differences between LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents, see [Frameworks, runtimes, and harnesses](/oss/python/concepts/products). For a side-by-side comparison with Anthropic's harness, see [Deep Agents vs. Claude Agent SDK](/oss/python/deepagents/comparison).

For building custom agents without these built-in capabilities, consider using LangChain's [`create_agent`](/oss/python/langchain/agents) or building a custom [LangGraph](/oss/python/langgraph/overview) workflow.

## Execution environment

The execution environment is where an agent acts. It has four layers:

* **[Tools](#tools-and-mcp)**: custom functions, APIs, and databases the agent can call
* **[Virtual filesystem](#virtual-filesystem-access)**: file tools backed by pluggable backends
* **[Filesystem permissions](#filesystem-permissions)**: declarative access control over which paths agents can read or write
* **[Code execution](#code-execution)**: sandboxed shell execution and an in-process JavaScript interpreter

**[Streaming](#streaming)** allows you to keep up with everything happening using typed event streams for messages, tools, values, and delegated tasks.

### Tools and MCP

Pass custom functions, LangChain tools, or tools from any [MCP server](/oss/python/deepagents/tools#mcp-tools) with the `tools=` parameter. Deep Agents fully support the [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](/oss/python/langchain/mcp), letting you connect to databases, APIs, file systems, and more through a standard interface.

```python theme={"theme":{"light":"catppuccin-latte","dark":"catppuccin-mocha"}}
from deepagents import create_deep_agent

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6",
    tools=[search, fetch_page, run_query],
)
```

For more information on defining custom tools, using MCP servers, and the full list of built-in harness tools, see [Tools](/oss/python/deepagents/tools).

### Virtual filesystem access

The harness provides a configurable virtual filesystem which can be backed by different [pluggable backends](/oss/python/deepagents/backends): in-memory state, local disk, LangGraph store, composite routing, or a custom backend with [permission rules](/oss/python/deepagents/permissions) for read and write access.

The backends support the following file system operations:

| Tool | Description |
| - | - |
| `ls` | List files in a directory with metadata (size, modified time) |
| `read_file` | Read file contents with line numbers, supports offset/limit for large files. Also supports returning multimodal content blocks for non-text files (images, video, audio, and documents). See supported extensions below. |
| `write_file` | Create a new file, or overwrite an existing one |
| `edit_file` | Perform exact string replacements in files (with global replace mode) |
| `delete` | Delete a file, or a directory and its contents recursively |
| `glob` | Find files matching patterns (e.g., `**/*.py`) |
| `grep` | Search file contents with multiple output modes (files only, content with context, or counts) |
| `execute` | Run shell commands in the environment (available with [sandbox backends](/oss/python/deepagents/sandboxes) only) |

> [!NOTE]
>
> The `delete` tool requires `deepagents>=0.7`. Backends that do not support deletion have the tool automatically hidden from the model.

> **Supported multimodal file extensions**
>
> | Type | Extensions |
> | - | - |
> | [Image](/oss/python/langchain/messages#multimodal) | `.png`, `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.gif`, `.webp`, `.heic`, `.heif` |
> | [Video](/oss/python/langchain/messages#multimodal) | `.mp4`, `.mpeg`, `.mov`, `.avi`, `.flv`, `.mpg`, `.webm`, `.wmv`, `.3gpp` |
> | [Audio](/oss/python/langchain/messages#multimodal) | `.wav`, `.mp3`, `.aiff`, `.aac`, `.ogg`, `.flac` |
> | [File](/oss/python/langchain/messages#multimodal) | `.pdf`, `.ppt`, `.pptx` |

> **Running without the default filesystem tools**
>
> To hide the filesystem tools listed above from the model, register a [harness profile](/oss/python/deepagents/profiles#harness-profiles) with `excluded_tools`:
>
> ```python theme={"theme":{"light":"catppuccin-latte","dark":"catppuccin-mocha"}}
> from deepagents import HarnessProfile, register_harness_profile
>
> register_harness_profile(
>     "anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6",
>     HarnessProfile(
>         excluded_tools=frozenset(
>             {"ls", "read_file", "write_file", "edit_file", "delete", "glob", "grep"}
>         ),
>     ),
> )
> ```
>
> Removing [`FilesystemMiddleware`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/deepagents/middleware/filesystem/FilesystemMiddleware) itself via `excluded_middleware` is intentionally rejected—it is required scaffolding in the [Deep Agents stack](/oss/python/deepagents/customization#deep-agents-stack). Use `excluded_tools` to hide only the model-visible tool surface and leave the middleware in place. To remove the `task` tool, see [Running without subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents#running-without-subagents).

> **Restricting filesystem tools**
>
> > [!NOTE]
> >
> > The `tools` allowlist on `FilesystemMiddleware` requires `deepagents>=0.7`.
>
> To expose only a subset of the filesystem tools listed above, instead of hiding them all, pass a `tools` allowlist to [`FilesystemMiddleware`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/deepagents/middleware/filesystem/FilesystemMiddleware) and provide the instance through `middleware=`. Any built-in filesystem tool left out of the list is removed from the model's tool list.
>
> ```python theme={"theme":{"light":"catppuccin-latte","dark":"catppuccin-mocha"}}
> from deepagents import create_deep_agent
> from deepagents.middleware import FilesystemMiddleware
>
> # Read-only agent: write_file, edit_file, delete, and execute are never shown
> agent = create_deep_agent(
>     model="claude-sonnet-4-6",
>     middleware=[
>         FilesystemMiddleware(backend=backend, tools=["read_file", "ls", "glob", "grep"]),
>     ],
> )
> ```
>
> `read_file` must always be included in the list—omitting it raises `ValueError` when the agent is created. The `execute` and `delete` tools are also dropped from the tool surface whenever the configured backend doesn't support them, whether or not you include them in `tools`. Custom tools you add through `create_deep_agent`'s own `tools=` argument are never affected by this allowlist.
>
> Passing your own [`FilesystemMiddleware`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/deepagents/middleware/filesystem/FilesystemMiddleware) instance this way replaces the default one for the main agent and the general-purpose subagent inherits the same restriction. See [Override a default middleware instance](/oss/python/deepagents/customization#override-a-default-middleware-instance) for more information. Declarative subagents don't inherit it: include a `FilesystemMiddleware(tools=...)` instance in that subagent's own `middleware` field to restrict it independently.

The virtual filesystem is used by several other harness capabilities such as skills, memory, code execution, and context management.
You can also use the file system when building custom tools and middleware for Deep Agents.

For more information, see [backends](/oss/python/deepagents/backends). To generate a durable repository wiki that agents can read from the filesystem, see [OpenWiki](/oss/openwiki/overview).

### Filesystem permissions

The harness supports declarative permission rules that control which files and directories the agent can read or write. Permissions apply to the built-in filesystem tools listed above and are evaluated in declaration order with first-match-wins semantics.

Define permissions by passing a list of rules to `permissions=` when creating the agent. Each rule includes:

* `operations`: `"read"` and/or `"write"`
* `paths`: Glob patterns for files or directories
* `mode`: `"allow"` or `"deny"`

Rules are evaluated top to bottom, and the first matching rule wins. If no rule matches, the operation is allowed.

This model lets you restrict agents to specific directories (for example, `/workspace/`), protect sensitive files such as `.env` or credentials, and give subagents narrower access than the parent agent.

Permissions do not apply to [sandbox backends](/oss/python/deepagents/sandboxes), which support arbitrary command execution via the `execute` tool. For custom validation logic, use [backend policy hooks](/oss/python/deepagents/backends#add-policy-hooks).

For the full rule structure, examples, and subagent inheritance, see [Permissions](/oss/python/deepagents/permissions).

### Code execution

Deep Agents supports code execution in two ways:

* [Sandbox backends](/oss/python/deepagents/sandboxes) expose an `execute` tool for shell commands in an isolated environment.
* [Interpreters](/oss/python/deepagents/interpreters) add an `eval` tool that runs JavaScript in a scoped QuickJS runtime.

Use sandbox backends when the agent needs to install dependencies, run tests, call CLIs, or work with an operating-system filesystem. Sandbox backends implement the `SandboxBackendProtocolV2`; when detected, the harness adds the `execute` tool to the agent's available tools.

Use interpreters when the agent needs a lightweight programmable layer for loops, batching, deterministic data transformations, or programmatic tool calling. Interpreters do not provide shell access, package installs, or filesystem and network access.

For sandbox setup, providers, and file transfer APIs, see [Sandboxes](/oss/python/deepagents/sandboxes). For the QuickJS runtime and programmatic tool calling, see [Interpreters](/oss/python/deepagents/interpreters).

### Streaming

[Event streaming](/oss/python/deepagents/event-streaming) exposes agent runs as typed projections for messages, tool calls, values, and output. Deep Agents add `stream.subagents` so each delegated task gets its own handle with independent message, tool-call, and nested subagent streams.

## Context management

The context management component controls what the agent knows, how long it can operate within token limits, and what it retains across sessions. It has four layers:

* **[Skills](#skills)**: on-demand domain knowledge loaded progressively from skill files
* **[Memory](#memory)**: persistent instructions and preferences loaded at startup from `AGENTS.md` files
* **[Summarization and context offloading](#summarization-and-context-offloading)**: automatic compression of conversation history and large tool results
* **[Prompt caching](#prompt-caching)**: static prompt sections are cache-eligible to speed up inference and reduce cost on supported models

### Skills

Skills package specialized workflows, domain knowledge, and custom instructions for your deep agent.

Each skill follows the [Agent Skills standard](https://agentskills.io/) and lives in a directory with a `SKILL.md` file. Skills can also include scripts, templates, reference docs, and other supporting resources.

Deep Agents load skills with progressive disclosure: the agent reads `SKILL.md` frontmatter at startup, then reads full skill content only when a task needs it. This keeps startup context compact while still making rich capabilities available on demand.

For more information, see [Skills](/oss/python/deepagents/skills).

### Memory

Memory gives your deep agent persistent context across conversations, such as coding style, preferences, conventions, and project guidelines.

Memory uses [`AGENTS.md` files](https://agents.md/) that you pass through the `memory` parameter when creating the agent. Unlike skills, memory files are always loaded, and the content is stored in the configured backend (`StateBackend`, `StoreBackend`, or `FilesystemBackend`).

The agent can also update memory based on interactions and feedback, so preferences and patterns can carry forward without needing to restate them in each thread.

For configuration details and examples, see [Memory](/oss/python/deepagents/customization#memory). To generate a repository wiki that coding agents discover through `AGENTS.md`, see [OpenWiki](/oss/openwiki/overview).

### Summarization and context offloading

The harness manages context so deep agents can handle long-running work within token limits while keeping the most relevant information in scope.

This context flow has four parts:

* **Input context**: System prompt, memory, skills, and tool prompts define what the agent starts with.
* **Compression**: Built-in offloading and summarization compress conversation history and large intermediate results.
* **Isolation**: Subagents quarantine heavy subtasks and return only final results (see [Delegation](#delegation)).
* **Long-term memory**: Persistent storage in the virtual filesystem carries information across threads.

Together, these mechanisms support multi-step tasks that exceed a single context window while reducing manual context trimming and token usage.

For configuration details, see [Context engineering](/oss/python/deepagents/context-engineering). For multimodal inputs and tool outputs, see [Multimodal](/oss/python/deepagents/multimodal).

### Prompt caching

For Anthropic and Amazon Bedrock models, `create_deep_agent` automatically applies prompt caching to static sections of the system prompt—the base agent instructions, memory, and skill content that repeat on every turn. This avoids reprocessing the same tokens across calls, reducing both latency and cost on long-running agents.

Prompt caching is enabled by default when using an Anthropic model, or a Bedrock model (Claude or Nova). No configuration is required.

For other providers, see [Middleware integrations](/oss/python/integrations/middleware) for available provider-specific caching middleware.

## Delegation

The delegation component enables agents to break large problems into smaller, parallelizable units of work. It has two layers:

* **[Task planning](#task-planning)**: an opt-in `write_todos` tool for structured task tracking
* **[Subagents](#subagents)**: ephemeral child agents that handle isolated subtasks

### Task planning

Task planning is an opt-in harness capability that lets agents maintain a structured task list during execution.

Starting in v0.7 task planning is opt-in only. In earlier versions, task planning middleware was included by default.

Planning is often useful for:

* Long or complicated multi-step tasks
* Less capable models that benefit from an explicit accountability tool
* UIs that stream progress from agent state (see [Todo list](/oss/python/deepagents/frontend/todo-list))

Pass [`TodoListMiddleware`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain/agents/middleware/todo/TodoListMiddleware) to the middleware parameter to give the agent a `write_todos` tool for maintaining a structured task list during execution.

```python Google theme={"theme":{"light":"catppuccin-latte","dark":"catppuccin-mocha"}}
from deepagents import create_deep_agent
from langchain.agents.middleware import TodoListMiddleware

agent = create_deep_agent(
    model="google_genai:gemini-3.6-flash",
    middleware=[TodoListMiddleware()],
)
```

### Subagents

The harness includes a built-in `task` tool that lets the main agent create ephemeral subagents for isolated, long-running, multi-step, or parallel tasks.
Two subagent types are available: synchronous subagents (the default) block the supervisor until they return a single report, and [async subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/async-subagents) run in parallel and support mid-flight steering via launch, check, update, and cancel tools.

Subagent execution provides:

* **Isolated or inherited context**: By default, each invocation creates a new agent instance with its own context (`mode: "isolated"`). Use `mode: "fork"` to inherit the parent's full conversation history instead. See [Forked subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents#forked-subagents).
* **Autonomous execution**: The subagent runs independently until completion.
* **Single handoff**: It returns one final report to the main agent.
* **Configurable strategy**: Use the [default `general-purpose` subagent](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents#default-subagent) (enabled by default) or define [custom subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents#custom-subagents).
* **Stateless messaging**: Subagents are stateless and cannot send multiple messages back.
* **Context and token efficiency**: Heavy subtask work stays isolated and is compressed into a compact result.

For more information, see [Subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents). To remove the `task` tool, see [Running without subagents](/oss/python/deepagents/subagents#running-without-subagents).

## Steering

The steering component gives humans control over agent behavior at runtime and sets filesystem permissions for agent work.

### Human-in-the-loop

Deep Agents integrate with LangGraph interrupts so you can pause for approval on sensitive tool calls. Enable this behavior with the `interrupt_on` parameter in `create_deep_agent`.

`interrupt_on` accepts a mapping of tool names to interrupt configurations. For example, `interrupt_on={"edit_file": True}` pauses before every edit, letting you approve the call, add guidance, or modify tool inputs before execution.

This gives you a runtime safety and control layer for destructive operations, expensive API calls, and interactive debugging.

For more information, see [Human-in-the-loop](/oss/python/deepagents/human-in-the-loop).

## Multiple MCP Servers
### Client
```
from langchain_mcp_adapters.client import MultiServerMCPClient
from langchain.agents import create_agent

client = MultiServerMCPClient(
    {
        "math": {
            "command": "python",
            # Make sure to update to the full absolute path to your math_server.py file
            "args": ["/path/to/math_server.py"],
            "transport": "stdio",
        },
        "weather": {
            # Make sure you start your weather server on port 8000
            "url": "http://localhost:8000/mcp",
            "transport": "http",
        }
    }
)
tools = await client.get_tools()
agent = create_agent("openai:gpt-4.1", tools)
math_response = await agent.ainvoke({"messages": "what's (3 + 5) x 12?"})
weather_response = await agent.ainvoke({"messages": "what is the weather in nyc?"})
```

## Documentation Index
LangChain agents call tools defined on MCP servers through [`MCPAdapter`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain/mcp/adapter/MCPAdapter), which discovers a server’s tools and adapts them into LangChain tools you can pass straight to [`create_agent`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain/agents/factory/create_agent).[`MCPAdapter`](https://reference.langchain.com/python/langchain/mcp/adapter/MCPAdapter) is built on [FastMCP](https://gofastmcp.com/), which handles transport inference, protocol negotiation, connection management, and authentication.

## [​](https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langchain/mcp#quickstart)  Quickstart
```
from langchain.agents import create_agent
from langchain.mcp import MCPAdapter

async def main():
    async with MCPAdapter("https://example.com/mcp") as adapter:
        tools = await adapter.list_tools()
        agent = create_agent("claude-sonnet-5", tools)
        return await agent.ainvoke({"messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "..."}]})
```

# Doudou

基于 [deepagents](https://github.com/langchain-ai/deepagents) 构建的**个人助手 Agent**。

支持自定义 **Tool**、**MCP**（Model Context Protocol）、**Skill**（Agent Skills 标准），
并通过**飞书（Lark）通道**与用户对话；需要网络服务时使用 **FastAPI** 对外暴露 REST / SSE 接口。

> 当前仓库处于**骨架搭建阶段**：目录结构与项目性文件已就位，业务代码尚未实现（源码文件内的 `# TODO` 即为待实现位置）。

---

## 1. 核心能力

| 能力 | 实现方式 | 对应模块 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 任务规划 | `TodoListMiddleware`（`write_todos`） | `doudou.agent.middleware` |
| 虚拟文件系统 | `FilesystemMiddleware` + 可插拔 backend | `doudou.agent.backends` |
| 子 Agent 委派 | `create_deep_agent(subagents=...)` | `doudou.agent.subagents` |
| 长期记忆 | `AGENTS.md` + `memory=` | `doudou.agent.memory` |
| Skill | Agent Skills 标准（`SKILL.md`） | `doudou.skills` |
| 自定义工具 | LangChain `@tool` | `doudou.tools` |
| MCP 工具 | `langchain-mcp-adapters` | `doudou.mcp` |
| 人在回路 | `interrupt_on` + LangGraph interrupt | `doudou.agent.factory` |
| 飞书通道 | `lark-oapi` + 事件回调 + 互动卡片 | `doudou.channels.feishu` |
| 会话路由 | 通道会话 → Agent thread 映射 | `doudou.gateway` |
| HTTP API | FastAPI + SSE 流式输出 | `doudou.api` |

## 2. 架构总览

```
                     ┌──────────────── 通道层 Channels ────────────────┐
   飞书用户 ──事件──▶ │  feishu   │   webhook   │   cli               │
                     └────┬─────────────┬──────────────┬────────────┘
                          │             │              │
                          ▼             ▼              ▼
                  ┌──────────── Gateway（会话 / 路由 / 运行）────────────┐
   HTTP 客户端 ──▶ │  session 映射 · 消息总线 · agent 执行 · 事件回流    │
   (FastAPI)      └───────────────────────┬───────────────────────────┘
                                          ▼
                        ┌──────── Agent Core（deepagents）────────┐
                        │  create_deep_agent                      │
                        │  ├─ middleware: todo / skills / fs      │
                        │  ├─ subagents                           │
                        │  ├─ tools  ◀── Tool Registry            │
                        │  │            ├─ builtin tools          │
                        │  │            └─ MCP tools              │
                        │  └─ checkpointer / store                │
                        └────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

设计原则：

- **通道与 Agent 解耦**：通道只负责「收消息 / 发消息」，所有编排逻辑集中在 `gateway`。
- **能力可插拔**：工具、MCP server、Skill 均通过配置声明，不写死在代码里。
- **配置驱动**：`config/*.yaml` 描述 Agent、子 Agent、MCP、通道；环境变量与密钥走 `.env`。
- **同一套 Agent 服务多渠道**：飞书、Webhook、CLI、HTTP API 共享同一个 Agent 实例。

## 3. 目录结构

```
Doudou/
├─ config/                    # 声明式配置（可提交，密钥放 .env）
│  ├─ config.example.yaml     # 主配置模板
│  ├─ mcp.servers.example.yaml# MCP server 清单模板
│  └─ agents.yaml             # 主 Agent 提示词 + 子 Agent 定义
├─ docs/                      # 设计文档
├─ skills/                    # Agent Skills（每个子目录一个 SKILL.md）
├─ deploy/                    # 部署相关（Docker / K8s）
├─ scripts/                   # 开发脚本
├─ src/doudou/
│  ├─ cli/                    # 命令行入口
│  ├─ config/                 # 配置加载与校验
│  ├─ agent/                  # deepagents 组装：模型/中间件/后端/子 Agent
│  ├─ tools/                  # 工具注册表与内置工具
│  ├─ mcp/                    # MCP 客户端与生命周期
│  ├─ skills/                 # Skill 发现与索引
│  ├─ channels/               # 通道实现（feishu / webhook / cli）
│  ├─ gateway/                # 会话路由、消息总线、运行器
│  ├─ api/                    # FastAPI 应用与路由
│  ├─ storage/                # 持久化（typing / 消息 / 通道绑定）
│  ├─ observability/          # 日志、链路追踪、指标
│  ├─ security/               # 鉴权与密钥处理
│  └─ utils/                  # 通用工具
└─ tests/                     # 单元 + 集成测试
```

各目录职责详见 [`docs/architecture.md`](docs/architecture.md)。

## 4. 快速开始

```powershell
# 1. 安装依赖（使用 uv）
uv sync --all-extras

# 2. 准备配置
Copy-Item .env.example .env
Copy-Item config/config.example.yaml config/config.yaml
Copy-Item config/mcp.servers.example.yaml config/mcp.servers.yaml

# 3. 启动 HTTP 服务
uv run doudou serve            # 等价于 uvicorn doudou.api.app:app --reload

# 4. 本地对话（不依赖飞书）
uv run doudou chat
```

飞书接入步骤见 [`docs/channels.md`](docs/channels.md)，MCP 接入见 [`docs/mcp.md`](docs/mcp.md)，
Skill 编写见 [`docs/skills.md`](docs/skills.md)。

## 5. 常用命令

```powershell
uv run doudou serve            # 启动 API 服务
uv run doudou chat             # 终端交互式对话
uv run doudou skills list      # 列出已发现 Skill
uv run doudou mcp list         # 列出 MCP server 及其工具
uv run doudou config show      # 打印生效配置（自动脱敏）
make lint / test / fmt         # 见 Makefile
```

## 6. 文档索引

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md) | 分层架构、模块职责、数据流 |
| [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md) | 配置项、优先级、环境变量清单 |
| [docs/channels.md](docs/channels.md) | 飞书通道接入与时序 |
| [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) | MCP server 配置与工具装配 |
| [docs/skills.md](docs/skills.md) | Skill 目录规范与编写指引 |
| [docs/tools.md](docs/tools.md) | 自定义工具开发规范 |
| [docs/security.md](docs/security.md) | 鉴权、密钥、权限与审计 |
| [docs/roadmap.md](docs/roadmap.md) | 里程碑与待办 |

## 7. 许可证

Proprietary（内部项目）。

# AGENTS.md

本文件是 Doudou Agent 的**长期记忆**（deepagents `memory=` 参数读取的文件），
同时也可作为 AI 编码助手（Claude Code / OpenCode / Cursor 等）在本仓库工作时的约定说明。

---

## 项目定位

Doudou 是一个个人助手 Agent，内核是 `deepagents.create_deep_agent`。
它需要支持：自定义 Tool、MCP server、Agent Skill、飞书通道，以及 FastAPI HTTP 服务。

**当前状态：骨架阶段。** 大部分模块只有模块级 docstring 与 `# TODO` 标记，功能待实现。

## 分层与依赖方向

```
channels ─┐
api ──────┼──▶ gateway ──▶ agent ──▶ (tools / mcp / skills)
          │                     │
          └──▶ config          └──▶ storage / observability / security
```

**依赖只能自上而下**，禁止反向引用：

- `agent` **不得** import `channels` 或 `api`
- `gateway` **不得** import 具体通道实现（`channels.feishu` 等），只能依赖 `channels.base`
- `config` 不得 import 其他业务模块
- 跨层共享的数据结构放 `channels.base` / `gateway.schema`

## 编码约定

- Python 3.12+，全量类型注解；`mypy --strict` 必须通过。
- 行宽 100，格式化与 lint 由 `ruff` 负责（`ruff format` + `ruff check --fix`）。
- 异步优先：I/O 一律 async；CPU 密集或阻塞调用用 `anyio.to_thread` 下沉。
- 配置读取**只**通过 `doudou.config.settings`，禁止散落 `os.environ`。
- 日志用 `structlog`（`doudou.observability.logging`），禁止裸 `print`（CLI 输出除外）。
- 异常：领域异常定义在模块内并继承统一基类；API 层由 `api.errors` 转成响应。

## 工具 / MCP / Skill 的约定

- **内置工具**放 `src/doudou/tools/builtin/`，每个模块一个主题，函数用 `@tool` 装饰并写清 docstring（LLM 依赖它理解用途）。
- **MCP** 只通过 `config/mcp.servers.yaml` 声明；代码里不出现硬编码的 server 地址。
- **Skill** 放仓库根 `skills/`，每个 Skill 一个目录 + `SKILL.md`（YAML frontmatter：`name`、`description`）。
- 有副作用的工具（写文件、发消息、调用外部写接口）需要在配置里登记为需人工确认（`interrupt_on`）。

## 测试

- `tests/unit/`：不依赖网络与真实模型，用 fake model。
- `tests/integration/`：标记 `@pytest.mark.integration`，默认本地可跳过。
- 新增模块时同步补测试文件占位与用例。

## 提交规范

Conventional Commits：`feat|fix|docs|refactor|test|chore|build|ci(scope): 描述`。
每个 PR 需通过 `make lint` 与 `make test`。

.DEFAULT_GOAL := help
PY := uv run
PKG := src/doudou

.PHONY: help
help: ## 显示所有可用目标
	@grep -E '^[a-zA-Z_-]+:.*?## .*$$' $(MAKEFILE_LIST) | awk 'BEGIN {FS = ":.*?## "}; {printf "  \033[36m%-16s\033[0m %s\n", $$1, $$2}'

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 安装
.PHONY: install
install: ## 安装全部依赖（含各 provider 与 dev）
	uv sync --all-extras

.PHONY: lock
lock: ## 刷新 uv.lock
	uv lock --upgrade

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 运行
.PHONY: serve
serve: ## 启动 FastAPI（开发模式，热重载）
	$(PY) doudou serve --reload

.PHONY: chat
chat: ## 启动终端交互式对话
	$(PY) doudou chat

.PHONY: serve-prod
serve-prod: ## 以生产参数启动 API
	$(PY) uvicorn doudou.api.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --workers 4

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 质量
.PHONY: fmt
fmt: ## 格式化代码
	$(PY) ruff format .
	$(PY) ruff check --fix .

.PHONY: lint
lint: ## 静态检查（ruff + mypy）
	$(PY) ruff check .
	$(PY) ruff format --check .
	$(PY) mypy $(PKG)

.PHONY: test
test: ## 运行单元测试
	$(PY) pytest tests/unit

.PHONY: test-all
test-all: ## 运行全部测试（含集成）
	$(PY) pytest -m ""

.PHONY: cov
cov: ## 测试并输出覆盖率
	$(PY) pytest --cov=$(PKG) --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html

.PHONY: pre-commit
pre-commit: ## 安装 git hooks
	$(PY) pre-commit install

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 辅助
.PHONY: skills
skills: ## 列出已发现的 Skill
	$(PY) doudou skills list

.PHONY: mcp
mcp: ## 列出 MCP server 与工具
	$(PY) doudou mcp list

.PHONY: config
config: ## 打印生效配置（脱敏）
	$(PY) doudou config show

.PHONY: clean
clean: ## 清理缓存与构建产物
	@rm -rf .pytest_cache .mypy_cache .ruff_cache htmlcov .coverage dist build
	@find . -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Docker
.PHONY: docker-build
docker-build: ## 构建镜像
	docker build -t doudou:local .

.PHONY: docker-up
docker-up: ## docker compose 启动
	docker compose up -d --build

.PHONY: docker-down
docker-down: ## docker compose 停止
	docker compose down

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

ARG PYTHON_VERSION=3.12

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- builder
FROM python:${PYTHON_VERSION}-slim AS builder

COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:latest /uv /uvx /bin/

ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy \
    UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never

WORKDIR /app

# 先只拷贝依赖描述，最大化利用层缓存
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock README.md ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --frozen --no-install-project --no-dev --extra anthropic

COPY src ./src
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --frozen --no-dev --extra anthropic

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runtime
FROM python:${PYTHON_VERSION}-slim AS runtime

ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PATH="/app/.venv/bin:$PATH" \
    DOUDOU_ENV=prod \
    DOUDOU_HOST=0.0.0.0 \
    DOUDOU_PORT=8000 \
    DOUDOU_ROOT_DIR=/data

RUN groupadd --system --gid 1000 doudou \
    && useradd --system --uid 1000 --gid doudou --create-home doudou \
    && mkdir -p /data && chown -R doudou:doudou /data

WORKDIR /app

COPY --from=builder --chown=doudou:doudou /app/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --from=builder --chown=doudou:doudou /app/src /app/src
COPY --chown=doudou:doudou config ./config
COPY --chown=doudou:doudou skills ./skills

USER doudou

EXPOSE 8000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
    CMD python -c "import urllib.request;urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health').read()"

CMD ["python", "-m", "doudou", "serve"]

name: doudou

services:
  api:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: doudou:local
    container_name: doudou-api
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      DOUDOU_ENV: prod
      DOUDOU_HOST: 0.0.0.0
      DOUDOU_PORT: "8000"

      DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL: sqlite+aiosqlite:////data/doudou.db
    ports:

    volumes:
      - doudou-data:/data
      - ./config:/app/config:ro
      - ./skills:/app/skills:ro
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: false

  # 可选：需要 Postgres 时启用（并把 .env 的 DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL 换成 asyncpg）
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine

volumes:

default_language_version:

repos:

name: ci

on:

# ============================================================================
# Doudou 主配置模板
# 复制为 config/config.yaml 后按需修改。
# 优先级：环境变量 > 本文件 > 代码内默认值（见 doudou.config.loader）
# 密钥类字段一律不要写在这里，放到 .env。
# ============================================================================

version: 1

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 运行环境
runtime:
  env: local                 # local | dev | prod
  debug: true
  log_level: INFO
  log_json: false            # prod 建议 true
  timezone: Asia/Shanghai

server:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 8000
  base_path: /api/v1
  workers: 1
  cors_origins:
    - http://localhost:5173
  # api_token 从环境变量 DOUDOU_API_TOKEN 读取，不在此处配置

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 模型
model:
  # provider:model 形式；也可写多行 fallback，第一个为主模型
  primary: openai:gpt-5.5
  fallbacks: []
  temperature: 0.2
  max_tokens: 4096
  timeout: 120
  max_retries: 2
  # 供自建/兼容网关使用
  base_url: null

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Agent
agent:
  name: Doudou
  system_prompt_file: prompts/system.md   # 相对 config/ 目录；留空则用内置默认提示词
  memory_files:
    - AGENTS.md                            # deepagents memory=，始终加载
  skills:
    - ../skills/                           # Agent Skills 根目录
  subagents_file: agents.yaml
  # 需要人工确认（LangGraph interrupt）的工具
  interrupt_on:
    write_file: true
    edit_file: true
    delete: true
    shell_exec: true
  # 单次运行的步数上限，防止死循环
  recursion_limit: 60
  # 文件系统权限规则，按顺序首匹配生效
  permissions:
    - operations: [read, write]
      paths: ["/workspace/**"]
      mode: allow
    - operations: [read, write]
      paths: ["/**/.env", "/**/*.pem", "/**/*.key", "/**/secrets/**"]
      mode: deny

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 虚拟文件系统
filesystem:
  backend: composite         # state | store | filesystem | composite
  root_dir: ./data/workspace
  virtual_mode: true
  # composite 模式下：以这些前缀开头的路径落到本地磁盘，其余放内存
  routes:
    - prefix: /workspace/
      backend: filesystem
    - prefix: /
      backend: state

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 上下文管理
context:
  todo_list: true            # 启用 write_todos
  summarization: true
  summarize_after_messages: 40
  keep_recent_messages: 12
  offload_large_results: true
  offload_threshold_bytes: 20000

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 存储
storage:
  database_url: sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/doudou.db
  checkpointer: sqlite       # memory | sqlite | postgres
  store: sqlite              # memory | sqlite | postgres
  echo_sql: false

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- MCP
mcp:
  enabled: true
  config_file: mcp.servers.yaml
  # 启动时拉取工具；失败是否阻塞启动
  fail_fast: false
  tool_name_prefix: true    # 给 MCP 工具加 server 前缀，避免重名
  call_timeout: 60

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 通道
channels:
  cli:
    enabled: true

  feishu:
    enabled: false
    base_url: https://open.feishu.cn
    bot_name: Doudou
    # app_id / app_secret / encrypt_key / verification_token 从 .env 读取
    event_path: /webhooks/feishu/events
    reply_mode: card         # card | text
    stream_reply: true       # 卡片流式更新
    card_update_interval_ms: 800
    allowed_chats: []        # 空表示不限制
    allowed_users: []
    group_require_at: true   # 群聊中必须 @ 机器人才响应
    max_reply_chars: 4000
    dedup_ttl_seconds: 600

  webhook:
    enabled: false
    token_header: X-Doudou-Token

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 可观测性
observability:
  langsmith:
    enabled: false
    project: doudou
  otel:
    enabled: false
    endpoint: null
  metrics:
    enabled: true

# ============================================================================
# MCP server 清单模板
# 复制为 config/mcp.servers.yaml 后按需修改（该文件已被 .gitignore 忽略）。
# 被 config.yaml -> mcp.config_file 引用。
#
# transport 取值：
#   stdio    : 本地子进程，需 command + args
#   http     : Streamable HTTP，需 url
#   sse      : SSE（兼容旧服务端），需 url
#
# 支持 ${ENV_VAR} 占位，从环境变量注入，避免明文密钥入库。
# ============================================================================

version: 1

defaults:
  enabled: true
  timeout: 60
  retries: 1

servers:
  # ---------------- 本地 stdio 示例 ----------------
  - name: filesystem
    enabled: true
    transport: stdio
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "./data/workspace"]
    env:
      NODE_NO_WARNINGS: "1"
    # 只暴露部分工具；留空表示全部
    include_tools: []
    exclude_tools: [delete_path]
    description: 本地文件读写

  # ---------------- 远程 HTTP 示例 ----------------
  - name: github
    enabled: false
    transport: http
    url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
    include_tools: [search_repositories, get_file_contents, create_issue]
    description: GitHub 只读 + 建 issue

  - name: fetch
    enabled: false
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: ["mcp-server-fetch"]
    description: 网页抓取

  - name: postgres
    enabled: false
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: ["mcp-server-postgres", "${DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL}"]
    # 该 server 的工具默认为只读，禁止 DDL
    exclude_tools: [execute_ddl]
    description: 只读数据库查询

# ============================================================================
# Agent 与子 Agent 定义
# 主 Agent 的提示词见 config/prompts/system.md
# ============================================================================

main:
  name: Doudou
  description: 用户的个人助手，负责理解意图、规划任务、调用工具并把结果讲清楚。
  # 由 create_deep_agent 默认注入：规划、文件系统、子 Agent、摘要
  # 此处只补充业务侧限制
  extra_instructions: |
    - 回复优先使用中文，除非用户使用其他语言。
    - 涉及外部副作用（写文件、发消息、提交代码）前，先复述将要执行的操作。
    - 不确定的信息不要编造；需要实时信息时先检索或调用工具。
    - 结果较长时用要点总结，而不是大段贴原文。

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 子 Agent
# 每个子 Agent 运行在独立 context，只把最终结论回传给主 Agent。
subagents:
  - name: researcher
    description: 联网检索与资料汇总，产出带来源的结构化调研结论
    system_prompt: |
      你是资料研究员，负责检索、比对与汇总。
      要求：给出结论时标注来源链接；区分事实与推断；无法确认时明确说明。
    tools:
      - web_search
      - http_request
    skills:
      - ../skills/research/
    model: null            # 留空继承主模型

  - name: coder
    description: 编写、修改与调试代码，可执行命令并跑测试
    system_prompt: |
      你是软件工程助手，负责实现与排错。
      要求：改动最小化；改完必须运行相关测试；说明改动点与风险。
    tools:
      - shell_exec
      - read_file
      - write_file
      - edit_file
    middleware:
      - filesystem_read_write   # 需要写权限
    interrupt_on:
      shell_exec: true

  - name: planner
    description: 把模糊目标拆解为可执行步骤与验收标准
    system_prompt: |
      你是任务规划者。输出：目标复述、假设、步骤清单（含依赖）、验收标准、风险。
      不要执行任务本身，只做规划。
    tools: []

声明式配置目录。**可以提交到仓库**，但真实密钥一律走 `.env`。

| 文件 | 是否提交 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |

input.content:
# 架构设计

## 1. 分层

```
┌───────────────────────────── 入口层 ─────────────────────────────┐
│  channels/{feishu,webhook,cli}     api/{routes}     cli/         │
└───────────────┬────────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                │  InboundMessage        │  RunRequest
                ▼                        ▼
┌─────────────────────────── gateway ──────────────────────────────┐
│  session（会话↔thread 映射）  bus（并发队列）                      │
│  router（分发）  runner（执行 + 事件回流）                        │
└───────────────────────────────┬──────────────────────────────────┘
                                ▼ agent 调用
┌──────────────────────────── agent ───────────────────────────────┐
│  factory（create_deep_agent 组装）                                │
│  models  middleware  backends  memory  subagents  permissions     │
│  checkpointer                                                     │
└───────┬──────────────────────────────────────────┬───────────────┘
        │ tools=                                   │ 依赖
        ▼                                          ▼
┌────────────────────┐              ┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ tools.registry     │              │ storage   observability      │
│  ├─ tools.builtin  │              │ security  utils              │
│  └─ mcp.client     │              └──────────────────────────────┘
│ skills.registry    │
└────────────────────┘
```

## 2. 模块职责

### 2.1 入口层

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `channels.base` | 定义 `Channel` 协议：`start()` / `stop()` / 把外部消息归一化成 `InboundMessage` / `send(OutboundMessage)`。 |
| `channels.registry` | 按配置实例化并启停通道。 |
| `channels.feishu` | 飞书长连接或事件回调接入，验签解密、去重、卡片渲染。 |
| `channels.webhook` | 通用入站 webhook，便于对接其他 IM / 自动化平台。 |
| `channels.cli_channel` | 终端交互，本地开发不依赖任何外部平台。 |
| `api.app` | FastAPI 应用工厂，挂载路由、中间件、异常处理。 |
| `api.routes.*` | HTTP 接口：健康检查、对话（含 SSE 流式）、线程管理、技能/工具/MCP 检视、webhook。 |

### 2.2 编排层 `gateway`

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `session` | 维护「通道会话标识 → agent thread_id」映射；并发锁、空闲过期、斜杠命令（如 `/new` 开启新会话）。 |
| `bus` | 进程内异步消息总线，按会话串行、跨会话并发。 |
| `router` | 把 `InboundMessage` 路由到对应 thread，组装 agent 输入。 |
| `runner` | 调用 agent、消费事件流、把增量结果推回通道（飞书卡片更新 / SSE）。 |
| `schema` | 层间共享的 `InboundMessage` / `OutboundMessage` / `RunEvent` 定义。 |

**关键点**：`gateway` 不 import 任何具体通道实现，只依赖 `channels.base` 协议，保证新增通道零侵入。

### 2.3 Agent 层 `agent`

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `factory` | 唯一的 `create_deep_agent` 调用点，把下面这些拼成 agent。 |
| `models` | 通过 `init_chat_model` 解析 `provider:model`，配置超时/重试/回退。 |
| `middleware` | 组装 middleware：`TodoListMiddleware`、`SkillsMiddleware`、`FilesystemMiddleware`、摘要与压缩。 |
| `backends` | 虚拟文件系统后端：`StateBackend` / `StoreBackend` / `FilesystemBackend` / `CompositeBackend`。 |
| `memory` | `AGENTS.md` 等记忆文件的加载与「助手回写记忆」。 |
| `subagents` | 从 `agents.yaml` 生成子 Agent 定义（各自 tools / skills / middleware / interrupt）。 |
| `permissions` | 文件系统读写权限规则，主 Agent 与子 Agent 分别生效。 |
| `checkpointer` | LangGraph checkpointer / store 选型（内存、SQLite、Postgres）。 |

### 2.4 能力供给

- **`tools`**：`registry` 汇总三类工具 —— 内置工具、MCP 工具、外部插件工具，并做重名检测与分组。所有工具进入 agent 前都是 LangChain `BaseTool`。
- **`mcp`**：`config` 解析 server 声明 → `client` 用 `MultiServerMCPClient` 建立会话 → `loader` 拉取并适配工具（含 include/exclude 过滤与名称前缀）→ `lifecycle` 随应用启停与健康检查。
- **`skills`**：`loader` 扫描 `skills/*/SKILL.md` 校验 frontmatter，`registry` 建索引，交给 `SkillsMiddleware` 做渐进式加载。

### 2.5 支撑

| 模块 | 职责 |
| --- | --- |
| `config` | `settings`（env）+ `schema`（类型模型）+ `loader`（合并优先级）。全局唯一配置入口。 |
| `storage` | SQLAlchemy 异步 ORM：线程、消息、通道绑定、审计。仓库类封装查询。 |
| `observability` | structlog 结构化日志、LangSmith / OTel 追踪、运行与工具指标。 |
| `security` | API 鉴权、通道回调验签、密钥读取与日志脱敏。 |

## 3. 两条主链路

### 3.1 飞书消息

```
用户发消息
  → 飞书开放平台事件推送（HTTP 回调）
  → api.routes.webhooks → channels.feishu.events（验签、解密、按 event_id 去重）
  → 归一化 InboundMessage
  → gateway.router：查 session 得 thread_id（无则创建）
  → gateway.runner：agent.astream_events(...)
  → 事件增量 → channels.feishu.cards 更新互动卡片
  → 落库（messages 表）+ 记指标
  → 3 秒内返回 200 给飞书（避免重推）
```

> 飞书要求回调在 **3 秒内**响应。因此 webhook 路由只做「验签 + 入队」，
> 真正执行放在后台任务，回复通过卡片更新或主动发消息完成。

### 3.2 HTTP 调用

```
POST /api/v1/chat            → 非流式，返回完整结果
POST /api/v1/chat/stream     → SSE，逐 token / 逐事件推送
GET  /api/v1/threads/{id}    → 历史消息
POST /api/v1/skills/reload   → 热重载 skills
```

## 4. 并发与状态

- 同一 `thread_id` 上串行执行，避免 LangGraph checkpointer 状态竞争；不同会话完全并发。
- 进程内状态（bus、session 内存映射）用单进程部署；要多副本时把 session 映射下沉到 `storage`，并把 `session` 加锁改为分布式锁。
- LangGraph 长任务：`recursion_limit` 限制步数，超时由 `runner` 强制取消。

## 5. 扩展点

| 想加什么 | 改哪里 |
| --- | --- |
| 新工具 | `src/doudou/tools/builtin/` 新增模块，`registry` 自动登记 |
| 新 MCP server | `config/mcp.servers.yaml` 加一条，无需改代码 |
| 新 Skill | 根目录 `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` |
| 新通道（如钉钉/微信） | `channels/` 新增子包并实现 `Channel` 协议，注册进 `channels.registry` |
| 新模型厂商 | `doudou.agent.models` 注册 provider，或直接装 `langchain-<provider>` 并用 `provider:model` 写法 |
| 换持久化 | 改 `DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL` + 对应 checkpointer/store 选型 |

# 配置说明

## 1. 优先级

```
代码内默认值  <  config/config.yaml  <  config/config.local.yaml  <  环境变量
```

- 密钥（App Secret、API Key、Token）**只放 `.env`**，绝不进 `config.yaml`。
- 环境变量前缀 `DOUDOU_`，嵌套用 `__` 分隔：`DOUDOU_SERVER__PORT=8080`。
- 模型厂商相关环境变量沿用官方命名（`OPENAI_API_KEY`、`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` 等），不加前缀。

## 2. 关键环境变量

### 运行环境

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DOUDOU_ENV` | `local` | `local` / `dev` / `prod` |
| `DOUDOU_DEBUG` | `true` | 调试模式，prod 下应关闭 |
| `DOUDOU_LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | 日志级别 |
| `DOUDOU_HOST` / `DOUDOU_PORT` | `127.0.0.1` / `8000` | 监听地址 |
| `DOUDOU_BASE_PATH` | `/api/v1` | API 前缀 |
| `DOUDOU_ROOT_DIR` | `./data` | 工作区根目录 |

### 模型

| 变量 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `DOUDOU_MODEL` | `provider:model`，如 `openai:gpt-5.5`、`anthropic:claude-sonnet-5`、`deepseek:deepseek-chat` |
| `DOUDOU_MODEL_TEMPERATURE` / `DOUDOU_MODEL_MAX_TOKENS` / `DOUDOU_MODEL_TIMEOUT` | 采样与限制 |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` / `OPENAI_BASE_URL` | OpenAI 或兼容网关 |
| `TAVILY_API_KEY` | 内置 `web_search` 工具 |

> 非 OpenAI 厂商需要装对应包：`uv sync --extra anthropic` / `--extra deepseek`。

### 存储

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL` | `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/doudou.db` | 业务库 |
| `DOUDOU_CHECKPOINTER` | `sqlite` | `memory` / `sqlite` / `postgres` |
| `DOUDOU_STORE` | `sqlite` | 长期记忆存储 |

### 飞书

| 变量 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `DOUDOU_FEISHU_ENABLED` | 是否启用 |
| `FEISHU_APP_ID` / `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` | 应用凭证（必填） |
| `FEISHU_VERIFICATION_TOKEN` | 事件订阅校验 Token |
| `FEISHU_ENCRYPT_KEY` | 加密模式密钥；留空为明文模式（不推荐 prod） |
| `FEISHU_BASE_URL` | 国内版 `https://open.feishu.cn`，国际版 `https://open.larksuite.com` |
| `FEISHU_ALLOWED_CHATS` | 白名单，逗号分隔 |

### MCP

| 变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DOUDOU_MCP_ENABLED` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `DOUDOU_MCP_CONFIG` | `./config/mcp.servers.yaml` | 清单路径 |

## 3. config.yaml 主要段落

`version` / `runtime` / `server` / `model` / `agent` / `filesystem` / `context` / `storage` / `mcp` / `channels` / `observability`

逐字段含义见 `config/config.example.yaml` 内注释。

几个容易踩坑的点：

- `agent.system_prompt_file` 相对于 `config/` 目录解析。
- `agent.skills` 里可以写多个根目录，deepagents 会把它们全部扫成 skill 索引。
- `filesystem.backend: composite` 时，`routes` 顺序即匹配顺序，最后一条务必是兜底。
- `agent.permissions` 首匹配生效，**兜底规则默认放行**，所以拒绝规则要写在前面。
- `channels.feishu.reply_mode: card` 才能用流式更新；`text` 模式只有一次性回复。

## 4. MCP 清单

见 `config/mcp.servers.example.yaml`。要点：

- 支持 `${ENV_VAR}` 占位，启动时从环境变量替换。
- `include_tools` / `exclude_tools` 用于收敛工具面（推荐显式收窄，减少模型误调用）。
- `fail_fast: false` 时单个 server 连不上只告警，不影响整体启动。

## 5. 校验与查看

```powershell
uv run doudou config check     # 校验配置合法性
uv run doudou config show      # 打印合并后的生效配置（脱敏）
```

# 通道接入

## 1. 通道抽象

所有通道实现同一协议（`src/doudou/channels/base.py`）：

```python
class Channel(Protocol):
    name: str
    async def start(self) -> None: ...
    async def stop(self) -> None: ...
    async def send(self, message: OutboundMessage) -> None: ...
    # 入站消息统一转成 InboundMessage 交给 gateway
```

`InboundMessage` 关键字段：

| 字段 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `channel` | 通道名，如 `feishu` |
| `conversation_id` | 会话标识（飞书为 `chat_id`；私聊用 `open_id`） |
| `thread_key` | 进一步区分话题的键（群内话题/回复链） |
| `user_id` / `user_name` | 发送者 |
| `text` | 纯文本内容 |
| `attachments` | 附件（图片/文件） |
| `raw` | 原始事件（排查用） |
| `message_id` | 通道侧消息 ID，用于回复与去重 |

## 2. 飞书（Lark）通道

### 2.1 创建应用

1. 打开[飞书开放平台](https://open.feishu.cn/app) → 创建**企业自建应用**。
2. 「凭证与基础信息」记下 `App ID`、`App Secret`。
3. 「权限管理」开通：
   - `im:message`（读取消息）
   - `im:message:send_as_bot`（以应用身份发消息）
   - `im:chat:readonly`（读群信息，用于群聊 @ 判断）
   - `im:resource`（图片/文件资源，如需收发附件）
4. 「事件订阅」：
   - 请求地址填 `https://<你的域名>/api/v1/webhooks/feishu/events`
   - 记下 `Verification Token`，如启用加密再记下 `Encrypt Key`
   - 订阅事件：`im.message.receive_v1`（接收消息）、`im.message.reaction.created_v1`（可选）
5. 本地开发时用内网穿透把回调暴露出去，或改用长连接模式（见 2.4）。

### 2.2 事件回调时序

```
飞书平台 ──POST/加密──▶ /api/v1/webhooks/feishu/events
                         │
                         ├─ crypto.verify_signature / decrypt
                         ├─ 首次配置：url_verification 握手 → 回 challenge
                         ├─ events.events 解析 → 按 event_id 去重
                         ├─ 立即 200（飞书要求 3s 内）
                         └─ 入 gateway.bus 异步处理
                                  │
                                  ▼
                    gateway.runner → agent 流式执行
                                  │
                    cards.build_* → 卡片创建/更新（PATCH）
                                  │
                                  ▼
                    飞书客户端显示增量内容
```

**为什么必须立即 200**：飞书对超时事件会重推，重推会导致重复回答。
`channels/feishu/events.py` 用 `event_id` + TTL 做幂等去重。

### 2.3 回复形态

| 模式 | 行为 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reply_mode: card` | 先发一张「思考中」卡片，随后按 `card_update_interval_ms` 节流更新卡片内容 | 推荐，体验接近流式 |
| `reply_mode: text` | 等 agent 跑完，一次性发文本 | 简单场景、卡片权限不足时 |

卡片相关能力集中在 `channels/feishu/cards.py`：

- 流式文本卡片（带「生成中」状态，结束后去掉）
- 工具调用过程卡片（可选，显示正在调用哪个工具）
- 人工确认卡片（配合 `interrupt_on`，提供「同意 / 拒绝」按钮回传）

### 2.4 长连接模式（本地开发友好）

若不想暴露公网地址，可使用飞书 SDK 的 WebSocket 长连接接收事件，
无需配置回调地址。切换方式：在 `config.yaml` 的 `channels.feishu` 下加

```yaml
mode: websocket        # callback（默认） | websocket
```

长连接模式下不经过 `/webhooks/feishu/events`，但仍复用同一套
`events` 解析、`gateway` 路由与 `cards` 渲染逻辑。

### 2.5 群聊策略

- `group_require_at: true`：群聊中只有 @ 机器人的消息才触发，避免噪音。
- `allowed_chats` / `allowed_users` 非空时构成白名单，其余一律忽略。
- 同一群聊默认共享一个 thread；如需每人独立上下文，把 `session` 的隔离粒度配置为 `per_user`。

### 2.6 去重与限流

| 项 | 做法 |
| --- | --- |
| 事件重复投递 | `event_id` 去重，TTL `dedup_ttl_seconds` |
| 卡片更新过于频繁 | 按 `card_update_interval_ms` 节流合并 |
| 用户刷屏 | 每会话一个执行队列，排队而非并发 |
| 回复过长 | 超过 `max_reply_chars` 自动截断并附完整内容落盘 |

## 3. 通用 Webhook 通道

`channels/webhook/` 提供一个泛化入站通道，便于对接任意系统：

```
POST /api/v1/webhooks/generic
Header: X-Doudou-Token: <token>
Body:   { "conversation_id": "...", "user_id": "...", "text": "..." }
```

响应可同步返回结果，也可 `?async=true` 只接受入队。

## 4. CLI 通道

`uv run doudou chat` 启动，支持：

- `/new` 新会话（换 thread_id）
- `/threads` 列出当前会话
- `/skills`、`/tools`、`/mcp` 查看已装载能力
- `/exit` 退出

## 5. 新增通道步骤

1. 在 `src/doudou/channels/` 建子包，实现 `Channel` 协议。
2. 在 `channels/registry.py` 注册构造逻辑（按配置启用）。
3. 在 `config/schema.py` 的通道配置里加对应段落。
4. 在 `api/routes/webhooks.py` 增加回调路由（如需要）。
5. 补 `tests/unit/` 解析与去重测试。

`gateway` 与 `agent` 无需任何改动。

# MCP 接入

## 1. 装配链路

```
config/mcp.servers.yaml
   │  mcp.config 解析 + ${ENV} 替换 + schema 校验
   ▼
mcp.client  ── MultiServerMCPClient（langchain-mcp-adapters）
   │           stdio / http / sse 三种 transport
   ▼
mcp.loader  ── get_tools() + include/exclude 过滤 + 名称前缀
   │           适配成 LangChain BaseTool
   ▼
tools.registry ── 与内置工具合并、重名检测、分组
   │
   ▼
agent.factory ── create_deep_agent(tools=[...])
```

MCP 工具和内置工具在 Agent 眼里没有区别，都是普通 LangChain 工具。

## 2. 清单格式

```yaml
servers:
  - name: filesystem              # 唯一名，用作工具前缀
    enabled: true
    transport: stdio              # stdio | http | sse
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "./data/workspace"]
    env:
      NODE_NO_WARNINGS: "1"
    include_tools: []             # 空 = 全部
    exclude_tools: [delete_path]
    description: 本地文件读写

  - name: github
    transport: http
    url: https://api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
    include_tools: [search_repositories, get_file_contents]
```

字段含义见 `config/mcp.servers.example.yaml`。

## 3. transport 选择

| transport | 何时用 | 关键字段 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stdio` | 本地进程型 server（npx / uvx 启动） | `command` + `args` + `env` |
| `http` | 远程 Streamable HTTP 服务 | `url` + `headers` |
| `sse` | 只提供 SSE 的旧服务端 | `url` + `headers` |

远程服务鉴权统一走 `headers`，值支持 `${ENV_VAR}` 占位，从环境变量注入。

## 4. 工具面收敛（重要）

MCP server 常常暴露几十个工具，全部交给模型会导致：

- 系统提示词膨胀、token 成本上升；
- 模型选错工具的概率上升。

因此：

1. `include_tools` 白名单优先，明确只给需要的；
2. 危险工具（删除、DDL、支付类）进 `exclude_tools`；
3. `tool_name_prefix: true` 时工具名形如 `github__search_repositories`，避免多 server 撞名。

## 5. 生命周期与容错

| 行为 | 配置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启动时拉取工具 | `mcp.enabled` | false 时完全跳过 |
| 单 server 失败 | `mcp.fail_fast` | false（默认）只告警并降级，true 则启动失败 |
| 调用超时 | `mcp.call_timeout` | 单次工具调用超时 |
| 健康检查 | `mcp.lifecycle` | `/health` 中报告各 server 状态 |
| 热重载 | `POST /api/v1/mcp/refresh` | 重新拉取工具列表，无需重启 |

`mcp/lifecycle.py` 与应用 lifespan 绑定，保证 stdio 子进程被正确回收，
避免容器里留下僵尸进程。

## 6. 排查

```powershell
uv run doudou mcp list            # 列出 server 与拉取到的工具
uv run doudou mcp list --tools    # 打印工具入参 schema
uv run doudou mcp check github    # 单独探测某个 server
```

常见问题：

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stdio` server 无工具 | 命令不存在 / 缺依赖 | 手动跑一次 `command args` 验证 |
| 401 / 403 | token 未注入 | 检查 `.env` 变量名与 `${...}` 占位是否一致 |
| 工具名重复 | 多个 server 同名工具 | 打开 `tool_name_prefix` 或改用白名单 |
| 启动变慢 | 每个 stdio server 都要拉起进程 | 只启用需要的 server |

# Skill 编写指引

## 1. 什么是 Skill

Skill 是**按需加载的领域知识与工作流**，遵循 [Agent Skills 标准](https://agentskills.io/)。
在 deepagents 里，`skills=` 会生成一个 `SkillsMiddleware`：

- 启动时只读取每个 `SKILL.md` 的 **frontmatter**（`name` + `description`），进入系统提示词，开销很小；
- 模型判断当前任务需要某技能时，才去读该 Skill 的完整正文与附属文件 —— 即**渐进式披露**。

它和工具的区别：**工具提供动作，Skill 提供做法**。需要外部动作时，Skill 里写明该调用哪个工具。

## 2. 目录结构

```
skills/
└─ example-echo/
   ├─ SKILL.md          # 必需：frontmatter + 正文
   ├─ reference.md      # 可选：详细参考（正文里让它按需 read_file）
   ├─ templates/        # 可选：模板文件
   └─ scripts/          # 可选：脚本
```

一个 Skill 一个目录，目录名建议与 frontmatter 的 `name` 一致。

## 3. SKILL.md 格式

```markdown
---
name: example-echo
description: 示例技能，演示 Skill 的最小结构与编写规范。当用户要求演示技能机制时使用。
---

# 正文

## 何时使用
...

## 步骤
1. ...
2. ...

## 注意
...
```

### frontmatter 字段

| 字段 | 必需 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | ✅ | 小写短横线命名，全局唯一 |
| `description` | ✅ | **决定模型何时加载它**，务必写清「做什么 + 什么时候用」 |
| 其他自定义字段 | ❌ | 会被解析但不要依赖，避免与标准冲突 |

`description` 是 Skill 能否被正确触发的关键，建议句式：
「<能力>。当 <触发场景> 时使用。」并包含用户可能说的关键词。

## 4. 配置

```yaml
# config/config.yaml
agent:
  skills:
    - ../skills/            # 仓库根 skills 目录，可多行
```

子 Agent 可以有自己独立的 Skill 集（`config/agents.yaml` 的 `subagents[].skills`），
此时只有该子 Agent 能看到这些 Skill。

## 5. 和工具的配合

Skill 本身不执行动作。需要动作时，在正文里指明使用的工具：

```markdown
## 步骤
1. 用 `web_search` 检索最近 7 天的相关新闻。
2. 用 `write_file` 把结果写入 `/workspace/report.md`。
3. 用 `http_request` 把文件内容提交到内部系统。
```

也可以给 Skill 绑定专属工具（`SkillsMiddleware(tools=[...])`），
即在 `agent/middleware.py` 的角色化 Skill 配置里声明。

## 6. 与记忆（AGENTS.md）的分工

| | Skill | 记忆 `AGENTS.md` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 加载时机 | 按需（模型判断） | 每次启动都加载 |
| 内容 | 特定领域的流程与方法 | 长期偏好与事实 |
| 体量 | 可以较大，含附属文件 | 要精简 |

「我喜欢用中文回复」→ 记忆；「写调研报告的标准流程」→ Skill。

## 7. 调试

```powershell
uv run doudou skills list                 # 列出发现的 Skill
uv run doudou skills show example-echo    # 打印 frontmatter 与正文
uv run doudou skills check                # 校验 frontmatter 完整性
```

触发不灵时通常是 `description` 写得不够具体，导致模型不认为该加载。

## 8. 热重载

`POST /api/v1/skills/reload` 重新扫描 Skill 目录，无需重启服务。

# 工具开发规范

## 1. 工具来源

| 来源 | 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 内置工具 | `src/doudou/tools/builtin/` | 随项目代码提供 |
| MCP 工具 | `config/mcp.servers.yaml` | 外部 server 动态提供，见 `docs/mcp.md` |
| deepagents 内置 | 框架提供 | `ls` / `read_file` / `write_file` / `edit_file` / `delete` / `glob` / `grep` / `write_todos` / `task` |
| 沙箱执行 | 沙箱后端 | `execute`（shell），需显式启用 |

全部在 `tools/registry.py` 汇总后交给 `create_deep_agent(tools=...)`。

## 2. 写一个内置工具

要点（不写实现，只定规范）：

1. 位于 `src/doudou/tools/builtin/<主题>.py`，一个模块一个主题。
2. 用 LangChain 的 `@tool` 装饰；函数名即工具名（蛇形小写）。
3. **docstring 是给模型看的**，必须写清：做什么、参数含义、返回值结构、何时不该用。
4. 参数用类型注解 + 默认值；复杂入参用 Pydantic 模型。
5. 返回字符串或可序列化结构；大结果要截断并说明截断（配合上下文卸载）。
6. 阻塞 I/O 用 async；同步 SDK 用 `anyio.to_thread.run_sync` 包一层。
7. 失败时**抛异常**并在消息里给出可操作的提示，不要返回 `"error"` 字符串让模型瞎猜。

### 命名与分组

| 前缀 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `web_` | 联网检索（`web_search`、`web_fetch`） |
| `fs_` / 直接动词 | 文件操作 |
| `note_` | 备忘与待办 |
| `<平台>_` | 第三方平台（`github_create_issue`、`feishu_send_card`） |

## 3. 副作用与人工确认

把工具分成三档，在 `config/config.yaml` 的 `agent.interrupt_on` 里登记需要确认的：

| 档位 | 例子 | 策略 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 只读 | 搜索、读文件、查库 | 直接执行 |
| 可逆写 | 写文件到 `/workspace/` | 记录日志，可选确认 |
| 不可逆 / 对外 | 删文件、发消息、提交代码、支付 | **必须** `interrupt_on` |

`interrupt_on` 生效需要 checkpointer（见 `agent/checkpointer.py`），
在飞书通道下确认请求会渲染成互动卡片按钮。

## 4. 注册与开关

- `registry.py` 负责：收集 → 过滤（按配置启用哪些分组）→ 重名检测 → 排序。
- 单个工具或分组可通过配置关闭（如 `tools.disabled: [shell_exec]`）。
- 需要 api key 的工具（`web_search`）在缺少 key 时应**自动不注册**，而不是运行时报错。

## 5. 测试

- `tests/unit/`：用 fake / respx 打桩外部依赖，验证入参校验与错误分支。
- 不要为工具写真实网络调用测试；放到 `tests/integration/` 并打 `@pytest.mark.integration`。
- 新增工具后补一条「工具清单快照测试」，防止工具面无意变化。

## 6. 清单

```powershell
uv run doudou tools list           # 名称 + 描述 + 来源（builtin / mcp:<server>）
uv run doudou tools show web_search
```

也可通过 `GET /api/v1/tools` 查看。

# 安全设计

## 1. 威胁面

| 面 | 风险 | 对策 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| HTTP API | 未授权调用、越权读他人会话 | `DOUDOU_API_TOKEN` 鉴权 + 令牌常量时间比较 |
| 飞书回调 | 伪造事件、重放 | 签名校验 + `event_id` 幂等去重 + 时间窗校验 |
| MCP server | 恶意 server 返回注入内容、危险工具 | 白名单 server、`include_tools` 收敛、`exclude_tools` 屏蔽破坏性工具 |
| 工具执行 | 越权读写文件、执行任意命令 | 文件系统权限规则 + `interrupt_on` 人工确认 + 沙箱 |
| 模型输出 | 提示词注入导致越权动作 | 工具层做硬校验，不信任模型输入 |
| 密钥 | 泄漏进日志、进仓库 | 只走 `.env`、日志脱敏、`detect-private-key` pre-commit |

## 2. API 鉴权

- `DOUDOU_API_TOKEN` 非空时，`/api/v1/**`（除 `/health`）要求 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`。
- 比较使用 `secrets.compare_digest`，避免时序侧信道。
- prod 环境建议在网关层再叠一层鉴权（mTLS / OAuth2），并限制 `cors_origins` 为明确域名。

## 3. 飞书回调安全

```
1) 存在 Encrypt Key  → 先 AES-CBC 解密 body
2) 校验签名/时间戳   → 拒绝超时与签名不符的请求
3) 校验 verification_token（配置期 challenge 除外）
4) event_id 去重（TTL = dedup_ttl_seconds）
5) 通过后才入队处理
```

- **prod 必须配置 `FEISHU_ENCRYPT_KEY`**，明文模式不适合生产。
- 回调地址必须是 HTTPS。
- 白名单：`allowed_chats` / `allowed_users` 非空即启用。

## 4. 文件系统与权限

deepagents 的文件系统权限按声明顺序**首匹配生效**，因此：

```yaml
permissions:
  # 显式拒绝写在最前
  - { operations: [read, write], paths: ["/**/.env", "/**/*.key", "/**/*.pem", "/**/secrets/**"], mode: deny }
  # 工作区放行
  - { operations: [read, write], paths: ["/workspace/**"], mode: allow }
  # 其余只读
  - { operations: [write], paths: ["/**"], mode: deny }
```

要点：

- 默认无匹配即**放行**，所以「只读兜底」必须显式写 deny。
- 子 Agent 需要更窄的权限时单独配置，不要指望继承。
- 沙箱后端的 `execute` **不受**权限规则约束，启用即等于放开 shell。

## 5. 人工确认（人在回路）

| 工具 | 是否确认 |
| --- | --- |
| 只读检索、读文件 | 否 |
| `write_file` / `edit_file`（限 `/workspace/`） | 建议是 |
| `delete`、`shell_exec`、对外发消息、提交代码 | **必须** |

确认请求会以互动卡片形式发到飞书，用户点「同意 / 拒绝」后继续或终止该次调用。

## 6. 密钥管理

- 单一入口：`security/secrets.py` 读取，其他模块禁止直接 `os.environ`。
- 日志与 `doudou config show` 输出自动脱敏（匹配 `*_KEY`、`*_SECRET`、`*_TOKEN`、`*_PASSWORD`）。
- 生产建议用容器 Secret / 云 KMS 注入环境变量，不要落盘明文。
- 轮换：`FEISHU_APP_SECRET`、`DOUDOU_API_TOKEN` 支持热更新（重启即生效，无需改代码）。

## 7. 审计

`storage` 中保留审计记录：

| 记录项 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 谁 | 通道 + user_id |
| 何时 | 时间戳 |
| 做了什么 | 工具名 + 参数摘要（脱敏） |
| 结果 | 成功/失败 + 耗时 |
| 是否确认 | 是否经人工批准 |

审计日志不可被 Agent 修改，也不放入模型上下文。

## 8. 运行时加固

- 容器以非 root 用户运行（见 `Dockerfile`）。
- `shell_exec` 默认禁用；启用时限定工作目录并设置超时。
- `agent.recursion_limit` 防死循环；`mcp.call_timeout` 与模型 `timeout` 防挂死。
- 依赖安全：CI 中可加 `pip-audit`；容器镜像定期重建。

# Research

把模糊的调研请求变成**可溯源的结构化结论**。

## 何时使用

- 需要外部信息才能回答的问题
- 方案对比、竞品分析、技术选型
- 需要给出处、不能凭空断言的问题

## 步骤

### 1. 界定问题

- 复述问题，写出 2–4 条**明确的调研子问题**。
- 列出已知信息与需要查证的假设。

### 2. 检索

- 用 `web_search` 检索，每轮针对一个子问题。
- 对高价值来源用 `http_request` 或网页抓取工具读原文，而不是只信摘要。
- 优先一手来源（官方文档、规范、公告），其次权威媒体，最后聚合内容。

### 3. 比对与溯源

- 为每条结论标注来源链接。
- 来源冲突时并列呈现，说明分歧点，不要静默取其一。
- 区分**事实**与**推断**，推断必须显式标注。

### 4. 成文

输出结构：

```
## 结论
（3–5 条要点，直接回答）

## 依据
（每条结论对应的来源与关键原文摘录）

## 不确定项
（未能证实、来源冲突、时效性存疑的部分）

## 来源
（链接列表）
```

## 注意

- 不要编造链接、数字或引用；检索失败要如实说明。
- 时效性敏感的问题要标注信息的发布时间。
- 内容较长时先给结论再展开，不要把原文整段粘贴。

部署相关文件。

| 目录 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `k8s/` | Kubernetes 部署清单（Deployment / Service / ConfigMap / Secret 模板） |

## 生产部署要点

1. **密钥**：`FEISHU_APP_SECRET`、`DOUDOU_API_TOKEN`、模型 API Key 通过 Secret 注入，不要写进 ConfigMap。
2. **配置**：`config/config.yaml` 与 `config/mcp.servers.yaml` 用 ConfigMap 挂载到 `/app/config`（只读）。
3. **Skill**：`skills/` 用 ConfigMap 或镜像内置挂载到 `/app/skills`。
4. **持久化**：工作区与数据库挂 PVC 到 `/data`；数据库改用 Postgres 时把 `DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL` 换成 `asyncpg`。
5. **探针**：readiness/liveness 用 `/api/v1/health`（应实现为不触发模型调用的轻量检查）。
6. **副本数**：状态在进程内（消息总线、会话映射），多副本前需先把会话与队列下沉到外部存储。
7. **超时**：飞书回调需 3 秒内响应，Ingress/网关的读超时应 ≥ 流式接口所需时长，SSE 接口需关闭缓冲。

kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: doudou-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: doudou
    app.kubernetes.io/component: api
spec:
  replicas: 1 # 状态在进程内，多副本前需先把会话/队列下沉到外部存储
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: doudou
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: doudou
        app.kubernetes.io/component: api
    spec:
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        fsGroup: 1000
      containers:
        - name: api
          image: doudou:latest
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["python", "-m", "doudou", "serve"]
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8000
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: doudou-config
            - secretRef:
                name: doudou-secrets
          env:
            - name: DOUDOU_ENV
              value: prod
            - name: DOUDOU_HOST
              value: 0.0.0.0
            - name: DOUDOU_ROOT_DIR
              value: /data
            - name: DOUDOU_DATABASE_URL
              value: sqlite+aiosqlite:////data/doudou.db
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health/ready
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /api/v1/health
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 30
            periodSeconds: 30
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
            limits:
              cpu: "2"
              memory: 2Gi
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /data
            - name: config
              mountPath: /app/config
              readOnly: true
            - name: skills
              mountPath: /app/skills
              readOnly: true
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: doudou-data
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: doudou-config-files
        - name: skills
          configMap:
            name: doudou-skills
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: doudou-api
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: doudou
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: doudou
  ports:

      port: 80
      targetPort: http
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:

spec:

  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 10Gi

# 仅存放非敏感配置；密钥请使用 Secret（参考同目录说明）。
# 生成方式：
#   kubectl create configmap doudou-config --from-literal=DOUDOU_LOG_LEVEL=INFO ...

kind: ConfigMap

data:
  DOUDOU_LOG_LEVEL: "INFO"

"""Logging configuration and structured log helpers."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import sys
from typing import Any

import structlog

_LEVELS = {
    "CRITICAL": logging.CRITICAL,
    "ERROR": logging.ERROR,
    "WARNING": logging.WARNING,
    "INFO": logging.INFO,
    "DEBUG": logging.DEBUG,
}

_configured = False


def configure_logging(
    *,
    level: str = "INFO",
    json_logs: bool = False,
    stream: Any | None = None,
) -> None:
    """初始化 structlog 与标准库 logging。

    日志统一走 ``stderr``，避免污染 CLI 与 SSE 的 ``stdout`` 输出。

    Args:
        level: 日志级别名（``DEBUG`` / ``INFO`` / ...），大小写不敏感。
        json_logs: ``True`` 输出 JSON（生产环境），``False`` 输出带颜色的可读格式。
        stream: 覆盖输出流，测试时可传入 ``io.StringIO``。
    """
    global _configured

    level_no = _LEVELS.get(level.upper(), logging.INFO)
    out = stream if stream is not None else sys.stderr

    logging.basicConfig(
        format="%(message)s",
        stream=out,
        level=level_no,
        force=True,
    )

    renderer: structlog.types.Processor = (
        structlog.processors.JSONRenderer(ensure_ascii=False)
        if json_logs
        else structlog.dev.ConsoleRenderer(colors=False)
    )

    structlog.configure(
        processors=[
            structlog.contextvars.merge_contextvars,
            structlog.stdlib.add_log_level,
            structlog.stdlib.add_logger_name,
            structlog.processors.TimeStamper(fmt="iso", utc=True),
            structlog.processors.StackInfoRenderer(),
            structlog.processors.format_exc_info,
            renderer,
        ],
        wrapper_class=structlog.make_filtering_bound_logger(level_no),
        logger_factory=structlog.PrintLoggerFactory(out),
        cache_logger_on_first_use=True,
    )
    _configured = True


def get_logger(name: str) -> structlog.stdlib.BoundLogger:
    """取一个绑定了模块名的 logger。"""
    return structlog.get_logger(name)


def is_configured() -> bool:
    """是否已调用过 :func:`configure_logging`（测试用）。"""
    return _configured


def reset_logging() -> None:
    """还原 structlog 默认配置（测试用）。"""
    global _configured
    structlog.reset_defaults()
    _configured = False


__all__ = ["configure_logging", "get_logger", "is_configured", "reset_logging"]

from __future__ import annotations

from doudou.observability.logging import (
    configure_logging,
    get_logger,
    is_configured,
    reset_logging,
)

__all__ = ["configure_logging", "get_logger", "is_configured", "reset_logging"]

"""Typed models for YAML config: agent, channels, mcp, storage.

这里的模型既是 ``config/*.yaml`` 的结构定义，也是默认值来源：
``config.yaml`` 缺失时，仅靠本文件的默认值也能启动。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

FilesystemBackendName = Literal["state", "store", "filesystem", "composite"]
CheckpointerName = Literal["memory", "sqlite", "postgres"]
PermissionMode = Literal["allow", "deny"]
PermissionOperation = Literal["read", "write"]


class _Section(BaseModel):
    """所有配置段的基类：拒绝未知字段，避免拼写错误被静默忽略。"""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- runtime


class RuntimeConfig(_Section):
    env: Literal["local", "dev", "prod"] = "local"
    debug: bool = True
    log_level: str = "INFO"
    log_json: bool = False
    timezone: str = "Asia/Shanghai"


class ServerConfig(_Section):
    host: str = "127.0.0.1"
    port: int = 8000
    base_path: str = "/api/v1"
    workers: int = 1
    cors_origins: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- model


class ModelConfig(_Section):
    """``primary`` 使用 ``provider:model`` 形式，例如 ``openai:gpt-5.5``。"""

    primary: str = "openai:gpt-5.5"
    fallbacks: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    temperature: float = 0.2
    max_tokens: int = 4096
    timeout: float = 120.0
    max_retries: int = 2
    base_url: str | None = None


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- agent


class PermissionRule(_Section):
    operations: list[PermissionOperation] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ["read", "write"])
    paths: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    mode: PermissionMode = "allow"


class AgentConfig(_Section):
    name: str = "Doudou"
    system_prompt_file: str | None = "prompts/system.md"
    memory_files: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    skills: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

    interrupt_on: dict[str, bool] = Field(default_factory=dict)

"""Pydantic Settings: env vars and .env loading.

两类来源分开建模，避免前缀规则互相干扰：

* :class:`EnvSettings` —— 带 ``DOUDOU_`` 前缀，嵌套字段用 ``__`` 分隔，
  例如 ``DOUDOU_SERVER__PORT=8080``、``DOUDOU_MODEL__PRIMARY=openai:gpt-5.5``。
  结构与 :class:`~doudou.config.schema.AppConfig` 一一对应，可直接深合并。
* :class:`Secrets` —— **无前缀**，沿用各家官方环境变量名
  （``OPENAI_API_KEY``、``FEISHU_APP_SECRET`` ...），只用于凭据。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pydantic import BaseModel
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict

_ENV_FILE = ".env"


class _EnvSection(BaseModel):
    """环境变量覆盖段的基类。

    字段全部可选：未设置的项不会出现在 ``exclude_none`` 的导出结果里，
    因此不会覆盖 YAML 中的值。
    """

    model_config = {"extra": "ignore"}


class EnvRuntime(_EnvSection):
    env: str | None = None
    debug: bool | None = None
    log_level: str | None = None
    log_json: bool | None = None
    timezone: str | None = None


class EnvServer(_EnvSection):
    host: str | None = None
    port: int | None = None
    base_path: str | None = None
    workers: int | None = None
    cors_origins: list[str] | None = None


class EnvModel(_EnvSection):
    primary: str | None = None
    fallbacks: list[str] | None = None
    temperature: float | None = None
    max_tokens: int | None = None
    timeout: float | None = None
    max_retries: int | None = None
    base_url: str | None = None


class EnvAgent(_EnvSection):
    name: str | None = None
    system_prompt_file: str | None = None
    skills: list[str] | None = None
    max_steps: int | None = None
    recursion_limit: int | None = None


class EnvFilesystem(_EnvSection):
    backend: str | None = None
    root_dir: str | None = None
    virtual_mode: bool | None = None


class EnvContext(_EnvSection):
    summarization: bool | None = None
    todo_list: bool | None = None


class EnvStorage(_EnvSection):
    database_url: str | None = None
    checkpointer: str | None = None
    store: str | None = None
    echo_sql: bool | None = None


class EnvMcp(_EnvSection):
    enabled: bool | None = None
    config_file: str | None = None
    fail_fast: bool | None = None


class EnvCliChannel(_EnvSection):
    enabled: bool | None = None


class EnvFeishuChannel(_EnvSection):
    enabled: bool | None = None
    mode: str | None = None
    base_url: str | None = None
    bot_name: str | None = None
    stream_reply: bool | None = None
    allowed_chats: list[str] | None = None
    allowed_users: list[str] | None = None


class EnvWebhookChannel(_EnvSection):
    enabled: bool | None = None


class EnvChannels(_EnvSection):
    cli: EnvCliChannel | None = None
    feishu: EnvFeishuChannel | None = None
    webhook: EnvWebhookChannel | None = None


class EnvSettings(BaseSettings):
    """``DOUDOU_*`` 环境变量。优先级高于 YAML。"""

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_prefix="DOUDOU_",
        env_nested_delimiter="__",
        env_file=_ENV_FILE,
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        case_sensitive=False,
        extra="ignore",
    )

    #: 配置文件目录，默认 ``./config``
    config_dir: str | None = None
    #: 显式指定主配置文件（相对 ``config_dir`` 或绝对路径）
    config_file: str | None = None
    #: 覆盖 ``config.local.yaml`` 的名字，测试用
    local_config_file: str | None = None
    #: HTTP API 访问令牌（非空即开启鉴权）
    api_token: str | None = None

    runtime: EnvRuntime | None = None
    server: EnvServer | None = None
    model: EnvModel | None = None
    agent: EnvAgent | None = None
    filesystem: EnvFilesystem | None = None
    context: EnvContext | None = None
    storage: EnvStorage | None = None
    mcp: EnvMcp | None = None
    channels: EnvChannels | None = None


class Secrets(BaseSettings):
    """无前缀的凭据，沿用各家官方环境变量名。"""

    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(
        env_file=_ENV_FILE,
        env_file_encoding="utf-8",
        case_sensitive=False,
        extra="ignore",
    )

    openai_api_key: str | None = None
    openai_base_url: str | None = None
    anthropic_api_key: str | None = None
    deepseek_api_key: str | None = None
    tavily_api_key: str | None = None

    feishu_app_id: str | None = None
    feishu_app_secret: str | None = None
    feishu_verification_token: str | None = None
    feishu_encrypt_key: str | None = None
    feishu_base_url: str | None = None

    langsmith_api_key: str | None = None

    def as_dict(self) -> dict[str, str | None]:
        """导出为字典，便于日志与 ``config show`` 脱敏展示。"""
        return self.model_dump()


__all__ = ["EnvSettings", "Secrets"]
